spriteBase: Use case: stylized-concept. Production sprite sheet for cozy anime pixel RPG, warm top-left light, dark brown tinted outlines, chunky pixel clusters, large head and small feet, matching the reference villager. Transparent background, NO text, NO grids, NO cast shadows, no ground. STRICT rectangular uniform grid FOUR columns SIX rows, 24 equal cells. Every cell contains exactly one whole character with ample transparent padding. Rows 1-3 idle: front, back (no face), right profile; all four columns repeat idle variations (pipeline uses first two). Rows 4-6 walk: front, back, right profile, four distinct step phases feet apart / passing / opposite apart / passing. Same character, clothes, accessories and proportions throughout. Feet baseline equal in each cell. Full body visible including head and shoes, nothing crosses cell boundaries. Reference shows existing approved style only; generate a NEW character.

portraits: Use case: stylized-concept. Cozy anime RPG PIXEL ART PORTRAIT atlas, 3 columns by 3 rows, nine equal square cells. Genuine transparent background, no words, no grid lines, no shadows. Each tile one head-and-shoulders bust facing slightly LEFT, with dark tinted brown outline, warm top-left light, chunky pixels and clear expression. Match the identities in reference overview, not full bodies. Row1 left to right: Tamsin elderly retired explorer grey braid brown explorer hat weathered coat olive scarf, show wrinkles and sixty-year-old face; Maren queen 19 chestnut shoulder-length hair thin gold circlet green dress cream apron tired eyes; Odo round cheerful baker curly brown hair rolled cream sleeves flour apron. Row2: Gus dark moustache straw hat blue-grey overalls ochre shirt soil hands; Mira auburn bun pencil behind ear burgundy shirt carpenter; Wren dark curls olive treat-pocket coat yellow bird shoulder. Row3: Juniper eight-year-old black messy hair patched mustard cloak slingshot; Brack grey stubble wide reed hat navy coat fishing rod; hero chestnut spiky hair ochre cloak cream collar satchel. Keep all faces in left three-quarter orientation. Each bust fits fully in tile with transparent margin.
lanternfly: Use case: stylized-concept. Production PIXEL ART sprite sheet FOUR columns ONE row, four equal square cells, one tiny round glowing lantern bug per cell, front view only. LANTERNFLY for cozy anime RPG: friendly round amber abdomen with warm golden glow contained INSIDE silhouette, small dark brown head, two antennae, two cream translucent-looking but opaque painted wings, dark tinted outline, warm top-left light. Four different flutter phases: wings high, wings halfway, wings spread horizontally, wings halfway folding. Identical body size and center in each frame. Genuine fully transparent background, no glow haze outside silhouette, no ground, no cast shadow, no text, no grid. Chunky pixel clusters, simple warm olive and brass palette matching cozy farming village sprites.
crops: Use case: stylized-concept. Pixel art crop atlas for cozy farming RPG. STRICT FOUR columns FOUR rows equal square cells, transparent background, NO soil block, NO pot, NO text, NO grid, NO shadow. Every plant viewed from SIDE with roots at same bottom baseline. Keep all stages at same scale so plants progressively grow, not individually enlarged. Row1 WHEAT four stages: tiny two-leaf green shoot, low green grass tuft, tall green stalk with immature ears, ripe golden wheat ears. Row2 TURNIP four stages: tiny sprout, small leaves, larger broad leaves and tiny pale bulb, mature broad leaves and round white purple-shouldered turnip bulb. Row3 CARROT four stages: tiny sprout, short feathery leaves, taller feathery leaves and small orange root, mature leafy carrot with large orange root visible. Row4 first two cells ONLY: mature green berry bush without fruit, same bush with red berries; last two cells empty. Dark tinted outlines, chunky 32px-style readable clusters, warm top-left light, muted moss greens wheat golds and earthy colors, no bright teal. Plants fit with transparent padding at sides and top.
icons: Use case: stylized-concept. Cozy anime RPG inventory PIXEL ART ICON SHEET. Four columns FOUR rows, 16 equal square cells, transparent background, one small icon centered per cell, clear dark tinted brown outline and warm top-left light, chunky readable pixel clusters with earth tones. NO lettering, NO grid, NO shadow, no repeated items. Row1 left to right: wooden PLANK; bundle of plant FIBER; MOSS TUFT; loaf of BREAD. Row2: bag of WHEAT SEEDS with wheat emblem no letters; HOE; metal WATERING CAN; SHOVEL. Row3: HAMMER; wooden WORKBENCH; wooden BED with cream blanket; closed wooden CHEST with brass latch. Row4: brass oil LAMP; bone-shaped pet TREAT; folded parchment MAP with red route; red HEART. Equal margins, each fits cleanly in own cell, same cozy ochre green rust brass palette as farming game. Designed to reduce to 32x32 pixels each.
panel: Use case: stylized-concept. Production pixel-art UI nine-slice parchment PANEL, one square panel only on genuine transparent background. Designed for final 96x96 pixels with 24 pixel fixed borders: all ornament restricted to corners and outer quarter border, center 48x48 flat warm cream parchment quiet and empty suitable for stretch. Thin dark brown ink double-line edges, small understated brass corner caps. Straight horizontal and vertical edges, front orthographic flat UI, no perspective, no text, no icons, no cast shadows, no curled paper, no ragged holes. Cozy farming anime RPG palette warm cream ochre brass brown, chunky pixel clusters and crisp edges. Panel fills almost entire square canvas.

title: Use case: illustration-story. Production PIXEL ART title-screen picture for cozy anime open world farming RPG, wide 16:9 landscape, final 480x270, opaque edge-to-edge. NO text or letters anywhere. Dawn in a warm green meadow near Hollowmere. Foreground small freshly tilled farming plot beside a HALF-BUILT COTTAGE, timber frame exposed and partial stone walls with only part of the thatch roof completed, stacked planks, quiet promise of a new home. Middle distance a winding river with little bridge. Background friendly small town with MUTED TEAL roofs and cream plaster, distant soft hills. Sunlight comes from upper left, pale peach and warm cream dawn sky. A long mysterious shadow enters from the LEFT edge across foreground grass, source outside image. Dark tinted outlines on nearby objects, chunky deliberate pixel clusters, gentle moss olive grass, ochre wood, quiet grey stone. Cohesive warm sprite RPG art, not photorealism, no smooth gradients, no bright luminous teal except muted teal town roofs. Peaceful storybook composition with distinct readable cottage and river.
